title: Descendant, child, adjacent and general sibling combinators
learningObjectives: Choose and write maintainable CSS selectors for descendant, child, adjacent and general sibling combinators.

understand.concept: A space selects descendants, > direct children, + the next adjacent sibling and ~ later general siblings. These express relationships in the document tree.
understand.whyItMatters: Good selectors target intended elements and keep styles maintainable.
understand.analogy: Selectors are like finding items in a list by their labels or relationships.
understand.analogyLimit: Selectors are not just labels; the document tree, state and specificity also matter.

explain.narrative: A space selects descendants, > direct children, + the next adjacent sibling and ~ later general siblings. These express relationships in the document tree.
